changes: audit-config.ts: added deprecatedGcThreshold:number (default 10) to AuditConfig interface, HARD_DEFAULTS, and resolveAuditConfig per-field override logic. audit-scan.ts: added scanDeprecated(projectRoot) returning {count,files} via grep, try/catch safe. audit-trigger.ts: wired deprecated advisory into hint when count > deprecatedGcThreshold. deprecated-gc-smoke.ts: 6-test smoke covering default threshold, config override, real-repo scan, above/below/at boundary.
usage: Advisory fires automatically at next audit trigger cycle. To lower threshold: add {"deprecatedGcThreshold": 5} to .lattice/audit-config.json. To see current count: node packages/main/dist/tasks/deprecated-gc-smoke.js (test3 prints real count).
expectedOutcome: Audit hint includes '⚠ @deprecated GC: N annotation(s) in M file(s); consider a cleanup story (threshold: 10)' when count > 10. smoke: deprecated-gc-smoke ok with 6 tests passing.
actualTranscript: node packages/main/dist/tasks/deprecated-gc-smoke.js: deprecated-gc-smoke starting... test1-6 all ok, count=22 in 5 files. deprecated-gc-smoke ok
outcomeDiff: No difference — actual matches expected. Real repo count is 22 > threshold 10, so advisory will appear at next audit cycle.
pitfalls: verificationIntent was missing (implementer recorded evidence before intent was set); needed verification_intent_repair --mode=fromEvidence. Two low findings from quality reviewer resolved in-session: F-001 (boundary test count===threshold), F-002 (misleading catch comment).
